# Aira Photography & Agnitantra Events

> Full-service wedding photography and event management in Kerala, India. One team handling photography, cinematography, stage decoration, catering, light & sound, makeup, transport and entertainment. Founded in 2018 by Amal Sebastian Kalarickal; nine years of weddings and celebrations across Kerala.

Aira Photography (visual storytelling) and Agnitantra Events & Caterers (full-service event management) operate as a single team based in Changanassery, Kerala. NAP: Kurishummood, Chethipuzha Kadavu, Changanassery, Kerala 686104 · +91 80897 03793. Rated 4.9/5 from 148+ Google reviews.

Primary services and location intent:
- Best wedding photography in Kerala — candid, cinematic, timeless.
- Best event management in Kerala — decor, stage, catering, sound, and more, coordinated under one roof.
- Areas served: Changanassery, Kottayam, Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur, and across Kerala; destination events on request.
